name: Joash
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Jehoahaz slept with his fathers and Joash his son reigned in his place.

note.label: 2 Kings 13: The Death of Elisha and the Arrows of Deliverance

points: Joash also did evil and departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, and he fought against Amaziah king of Judah.

note.label: 2 Kings 13: The Death of Elisha and the Arrows of Deliverance

points: Elisha fell sick of the sickness he would die of, and Joash king of Israel came and wept over him, calling him the chariot of Israel and the horsemen thereof.

note.label: 2 Kings 13: The Death of Elisha and the Arrows of Deliverance

points: After Hazael died, Jehoash beat Ben-hadad his son three times and recovered the cities of Israel, according to the word Elisha spoke.

note.label: 2 Kings 13: The Death of Elisha and the Arrows of Deliverance

points: Amaziah sent to Jehoash king of Israel to face one another in battle, and Jehoash answered with the parable of the thistle and the cedar, warning him to stay home lest he fall.

note.label: 2 Kings 14: Amaziah, the Imperfect Heart, and Jeroboam II

points: Jehoash slept with his fathers and Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.

note.label: 2 Kings 14: Amaziah, the Imperfect Heart, and Jeroboam II

points: Amaziah lived fifteen years after the death of Jehoash, and a conspiracy was made against him in Jerusalem so that he fled to Lachish and was slain there.

note.label: 2 Kings 14: Amaziah, the Imperfect Heart, and Jeroboam II

points: Jeroboam the son of Joash, Jeroboam II, began to reign over Israel and reigned forty-one years, doing evil and not departing from the sins of the first Jeroboam.

note.label: 2 Kings 14: Amaziah, the Imperfect Heart, and Jeroboam II

points: Amaziah took advice and sent to Joash king of Israel saying, Come, let us see one another in the face. Joash answered with a parable of the thistle and the cedar, telling him his heart lifted him up to boast, and to abide at home rather than meddle to his hurt.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 25: Amaziah Serves the Most High With a Divided Heart

points: The word of the Lord came unto Hosea the son of Beeri in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

note.label: Hosea 1: A Wife of Whoredoms and the Sand of the Sea

points: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

note.label: Amos 1: For Three Transgressions and For Four
